_about: Made-up scripted replies for DA_LLM_PROVIDER=fake in Build (Phase 6). Round 1 of excel_processor.py has a bug (hidden sheets are not skipped), so some tests fail; the fix round repairs only that file. The fake plan creates src/agents/excel_processor.py and modifies src/agents/upload_validator.py.

items.name: read_sheets
items.summary: Return the rows of every visible, non-empty sheet by sheet name; raise ValueError when there is none.

items.name: validate
items.summary: Say whether the file type is allowed (pdf, docx and xlsx).
